subject: Insurance
title: The UK's Whiplash Problem
description: Learn The UK's Whiplash Problem in one minute.

hook.text: The UK was called the 'whiplash capital of the world.' 800,000 claims a year despite falling accident rates.

buildup.text: No-win, no-fee lawyers encouraged minor accident victims to claim.

discovery.text: Claim farming companies cold-called accident victims, pressuring them to file. Some victims hadn't even been injured.

twist.text: The UK passed the Whiplash Reform Programme in 2021, capping payouts for minor injuries.

climax.text: The UK's whiplash crisis showed how legal incentives can inflate insurance costs.

punchline.text: 800,000 whiplash claims, falling accidents. New laws cut claims 30% in one year.

quiz.question: How did the UK reduce its whiplash claim epidemic?
options: Capped payouts for minor injuries through legislation
